title: Where the rows went
prompt: What does this program print? `profile` is the lesson's helper; the loop prints each step's rows, or the rows it shuffled for an `Exchange`. Of the 12 lesson trips, 6 were paid by card and are longer than 2 miles, and 3 drivers drove them. `trips` is one CSV file of 1,436 bytes. Type each printed line on its own line.
hints: Plans print top-down, so the scan of the file comes last.
Simple conditions on columns are pushed into the CSV reader, so the scan hands on only the rows that match. It still reads the whole file to find them.
A grouping adds up rows within each partition before the shuffle and again after it. `trips` is one partition.
